retainedEntity.assessment: Retained block entity differs from its current block. Dedicated recovery assessment required; generic remapping is blocked. Serialized item stacks found; no items have been restored.

limits: Retained bookshelf and historical snapshot data were deliberately seeded into a disposable test world, not recovered from the production server.
No authenticated game clients or production containers were modified.
No automatic inventory restoration is implemented. Finding records does not establish a safe recovery.
Existing snapshots contain slot codes and quantities only; full item attributes and later transfers are not reconstructed.
Custom/oversized or unsupported saved attributes can be marked partial/refused.
Generic block-entity replacement stays blocked; lighting/map caches may require refreshing after ordinary ID repair.
